design_summary: Handbook-style editorial system: system serif headings (Iowan/Palatino), system sans body, warm paper, charcoal ink, and Cornell red reserved for links, current state and the answer rule. Structure comes from thin and 2px rules plus small tracked labels, not cards. Home leads with search, then a theme index beside the question list. Articles read answer, worked explanation, sources in a 40rem column with a sticky rail. Templates use single-quoted attributes; HTML comments state each slot's expected markup. List slots expect a complete ul. Wrap wide tables in .table-wrap and display equations in .equation for contained scrolling; the CSS fallbacks for unwrapped math are untested, so check them in your local build.
